plugins.name: vstack
plugins.description: Evidence-led engineering workflows to plan, build, review, and ship software with AI agents. Part of the vllnt universe: open, sovereign tools for freedom by design (vllnt.com).

skills.name: build-landing-page
skills.description: Draft or review framework-independent landing-page structure and conversion copy for one primary action.
skills.description_zh: 围绕一个主要行动起草或审查不依赖框架的落地页结构及转化文案。

skills.name: build-project
skills.description: Establish and verify a minimal project baseline from applicable stack and package preferences.
skills.description_zh: 依据适用技术栈及包偏好建立并验证最小项目基线。

skills.name: build-prototype
skills.description: Build and iterate a focused local prototype using observed behavior and human product decisions.
skills.description_zh: 依据已观察行为和人工产品决策构建迭代聚焦的本地原型。

skills.name: deliver-issue
skills.description: Deliver a scoped issue through a verified pull request and authorized merge to its target branch.
skills.description_zh: 通过已验证PR及获授权合并到目标分支交付范围明确的issue。

skills.name: deliver-pull-request
skills.description: Review a pull request, coordinate authorized repairs and verification, then merge it when permitted.
skills.description_zh: 审查PR，协调获授权修复及验证，并在允许时合并。

skills.name: explain-subject
skills.description: Explain a real subject with a simple verified mental model and clear limits.
skills.description_zh: 用简单且经核验的理解模型解释真实主题，明确适用边界。

skills.name: explore-decisions
skills.description: Sharpen an artifact or decision through focused evidence-based questions and concrete alternatives.
skills.description_zh: 通过聚焦证据的问题及具体替代方案完善产物或决策。

skills.name: improve-code
skills.description: Simplify code and comments while preserving observable contracts and affected consumers.
skills.description_zh: 简化代码及注释，同时保留可观察契约和受影响使用方行为。

skills.name: improve-project
skills.description: Adapt an existing repository to applicable stack preferences through small verified stages.
skills.description_zh: 通过小步验证使既有仓库适配适用技术栈偏好。

skills.name: improve-ui
skills.description: Improve an interface’s hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, and accessibility while preserving journeys.
skills.description_zh: 在保留用户旅程的同时改善界面层级、一致性、响应式和无障碍。

skills.name: manage-defects
skills.description: Diagnose a reported failure, isolate its cause, and apply authorized repairs with regression evidence.
skills.description_zh: 诊断已报告失败、隔离原因，并执行获授权修复且提供回归证据。

skills.name: manage-issues
skills.description: Triage GitHub issues into an evidence-backed, atomic, actionable backlog and apply authorized changes.
skills.description_zh: 将GitHub issues分流为有证据、原子化且可行动的待办，并执行授权修改。

skills.name: manage-roadmap
skills.description: Create, maintain, synchronize, or report a traceable roadmap that preserves direction and history.
skills.description_zh: 创建维护同步或报告可追溯路线图，保留方向及历史。

skills.name: manage-rules
skills.description: Manage user, project, and nested instructions while preserving scope, precedence, and effective behavior.
skills.description_zh: 管理用户、项目及嵌套指令，保留作用范围、优先级和有效行为。

skills.name: manage-skills
skills.description: Create, review, update, organize, or retire portable agent skills around a clear outcome and evidence.
skills.description_zh: 围绕明确成果及证据创建、审查、更新、组织或淘汰便携智能体技能。

skills.name: manage-vision
skills.description: Create, update, locate, or audit an evidence-backed project vision anchor and decision test.
skills.description_zh: 创建、更新、定位或审计有证据的项目愿景依据及决策检验标准。

skills.name: plan-issues
skills.description: Assess a codebase and prepare a source-backed, deduplicated issue backlog for human review.
skills.description_zh: 评估代码库，准备有来源且去重的issue待办供人工审查。

skills.name: plan-work
skills.description: Maintain a read-only planning session that returns an actionable plan without local or remote side effects.
skills.description_zh: 开展只读规划会话，返回可行动计划且不产生本地或远端副作用。

skills.name: review-ui
skills.description: Assess an interface for evidence-backed usability, responsiveness, consistency, and accessibility findings without changing it.
skills.description_zh: 只读评估界面可用性、响应式、一致性和无障碍，输出有证据发现。

skills.name: vllnt-collaboration-principles
skills.description: Load at each session start to keep human collaboration proactive, concise, autonomous, and decision-ready.
skills.description_zh: 在会话开始加载Vstack的人机协作原则，保持主动、简明、自主并便于决策的协作。

skills.name: vllnt-orchestration-principles
skills.description: Load at each session start to coordinate goal-driven work, useful delegation, convergence, and decisions.
skills.description_zh: 在会话开始加载编排原则，协调目标驱动工作、有效委派、收敛及决策。

skills.name: vllnt-thinking-principles
skills.description: Load at each session start to apply Vstack’s evidence-led, minimal reasoning principles throughout the work.
skills.description_zh: 在会话开始加载Vstack以证据为依据的简明推理原则，贯穿后续工作。
